formats.key: ExecutionData(OfferExecution[] offerExecution,uint256 loanId,address nftCollateralAddress,uint256 tokenId,uint256 duration,uint256 expirationTime,address principalReceiver,bytes callbackData)LoanOffer(uint256 offerId,address lender,uint256 fee,uint256 capacity,address nftCollateralAddress,uint256 nftCollateralTokenId,address principalAddress,uint256 principalAmount,uint256 aprBps,uint256 expirationTime,uint256 duration,uint256 maxSeniorRepayment,OfferValidator[] validators,bool lenderRefinanceDisabled,address borrower)OfferValidator(address validator,bytes arguments)
effects: The signature lets anyone call emitLoan or refinanceFromLoanExecutionData for the borrower until expirationTime (_validateExecutionData checks the borrower signature when msg.sender != borrower).

New loan: the NFT nftCollateralAddress #tokenId moves from the borrower into escrow in the MultiSourceLoan contract (emitLoan: ERC721.transferFrom(borrower, address(this), tokenId)). If the loan is not repaid in time it can be liquidated.
For each offer, the lender sends amount - fee of principalAddress to principalReceiver. fee = offer.fee * amount / offer.principalAmount, so it is at most offer.fee (_processOffersFromExecutionData).
A debt is created in the borrower's name: one tranche per offer for `amount` at offer.aprBps over `duration`. Repayment is principal plus interest.

Refinance (loanId != 0): the borrower's wallet pays every old tranche's principal, accrued interest and new interest to the old lenders, plus the protocol fee on that interest (_processRepayments: safeTransferFrom(loan.borrower, tranche.lender, repayment)). The old loan is deleted and a new loan id holds the NFT.
If lenderRefinanceDisabled is set, the loan cannot be refinanced by lenders, it must have a single tranche, and a later refinance has to send the principal to the borrower.
If callbackData is not empty, the whitelisted caller contract's afterPrincipalTransfer runs with that data after the principal is transferred.
formats.shown: "Borrow against <NFT>" with the collateral NFT, then per offer the lender, gross amount in the principal token, APR, max lender fee and a raw no-refinance flag, then duration, principal receiver, signature expiry, raw callback data and, for a refinance, the raw loan id.

findings.title: Refinance: the old loan's repayment from the borrower's wallet is not stated; only a raw loan id is shown.
findings.evidence: MultiSourceLoan.sol refinanceFromLoanExecutionData -> _processRepayments: `asset.safeTransferFrom(loan.borrower, tranche.lender, repayment)` and `asset.safeTransferFrom(loan.borrower, _protocolFee.recipient, totalProtocolFee)`. Descriptor: interpolatedIntent "Borrow against {tokenId}". The field `loanId` is labelled 'Loan to refinance' (raw). Case 1 shows only 'Loan to refinance: 15551'.
findings.fix: Label loanId 'Repays loan # (from your wallet)'. Make the intent say that a refinance repays the existing loan's principal plus interest from your wallet. The amount comes from storage and cannot be shown.

findings.title: Refinance repayment amount is read from the stored loan and cannot be shown from the message.
findings.evidence: refinanceFromLoanExecutionData takes `Loan calldata _loan` outside the signed ExecutionData. The repayment is tranche.principalAmount + accruedInterest + newInterest (_processRepayments).
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A wallet would need to read the loan from on-chain state.

findings.title: 'Amount' is the gross principal; the receiver gets amount minus a pro-rata lender fee.
findings.evidence: _processOffersFromExecutionData: `fee = offer.fee.mulDivUp(amount, offer.principalAmount)` and `safeTransferFrom(lender, _principalReceiver, amount - fee)`. Descriptor: `offerExecution.[].amount` is labelled 'Amount' and `offer.fee` is labelled 'Lender fee (max)'.
findings.fix: Label the amount 'Principal borrowed (before lender fee)', or explain in the fee label that it is deducted from the principal you receive.

findings.title: Per-offer terms are separate array fields that the signer cannot pair when there are several offers.
findings.evidence: Separate fields `offerExecution.[].offer.lender`, `offerExecution.[].amount`, `offerExecution.[].offer.aprBps`, `offerExecution.[].offer.fee` and `offerExecution.[].offer.lenderRefinanceDisabled`, with no group on `offerExecution.[]`.
findings.fix: Put lender, amount, APR and fee in one field group iterated over offerExecution.[] so each tranche reads together.

findings.title: 'No lender refinance' shows a raw true/false and does not explain what the flag restricts.
findings.evidence: Descriptor field `offerExecution.[].offer.lenderRefinanceDisabled` with format raw, shown as 'No lender refinance: true' in cases 0 and 1. Code: a single tranche is required, and a refinance must send the principal to the borrower (`if (_loan.lenderRefinanceDisabled && executionData.principalReceiver != borrower) revert`).
findings.fix: Use an enum or label such as 'Lenders cannot refinance this loan: Yes/No'.

findings.title: Callback data is shown as raw bytes; it runs on the caller's whitelisted callback contract.
findings.evidence: emitLoan: `if (_hasCallback(executionData.callbackData)) handleAfterPrincipalTransferCallback(loan, msg.sender, executionData.callbackData, totalFee)`. Descriptor: `callbackData` 'Callback data' (raw).
findings.fix: Hide it when it is empty (ifNotIn ['0x']), or add a message that a non-empty value triggers a follow-up action after the principal is sent.

findings.title: The intent does not say the NFT is locked in escrow and can be liquidated if unpaid.
findings.fix: For example: "Lock {tokenId} as collateral to borrow".

findings.title: No case covers several offers, a non-zero lender fee or non-empty callback data.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json and cases/1.json each have one offer with fee "0" and callbackData "0x".
findings.fix: Add a case with two tranches, a non-zero fee and non-empty callback data.
